field.label: Brand attribute code
field.comment: The product attribute the dashboard groups by as "Brand". Default: manufacturer.

field.label: Dashboard shows enabled products only by default
field.comment: The "Enabled products only" switch on the dashboard starts in this position.

field.label: Work list rows per page
field.comment: Default page size of the dashboard work list.

field.label: CSV export row cap
field.comment: The most rows one CSV export writes. Narrow the filters to export a longer list in parts.

group.label: Score bands
group.comment: Complete is always 100. Good starts at the first threshold, Needs work at the second, Poor is below it.

field.label: Good from
field.comment: A score from this value up to 99 is Good. Default 80.

field.label: Needs work from
field.comment: A score from this value up to the Good threshold is Needs work; below it is Poor. Default 50.

group.label: Periodic rescore
group.comment: Rescores the catalog from Magento cron on a schedule, so changes that no save announces, such as an ERP sync or a script writing straight to the database, still reach the scores. Product saves, mass attribute updates and imports rescore at once without it, and Recalculate on the dashboard works as before.

field.label: Rescore on a schedule
field.comment: Runs as the cron job bce_completeness_rescore in its own cron group, bce_completeness, so Magento cron must run. Each run writes its count and duration to var/log/bce_completeness.log.

field.label: Schedule
field.comment: A cron expression in five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week. The default, 0 */6 * * *, runs every six hours.

field.label: Products to rescore
field.comment: Products changed since the last run reads each product's updated_at, which Magento's own saves and imports set but many direct database writes leave alone, so choose it only when your sync sets updated_at too. A run with no earlier run on record, or without a usable updated_at, rescores every product.

field.label: Products per batch
field.comment: How many products a run loads and scores at a time, one product ID range after another. Lower it if cron runs out of memory. From 50 to 5000; default 500.
